text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm... finally... finished. Fifty sprints
down!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel so heavy... and my legs are like
jelly!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is this scale broken or something? When
did I put
on all this weight?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... I have to lose it! And no one can
ever
know!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll never become a top Umadol if I just
mope
around!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll lose the extra weight and be right
back to
being everybody's lovable Falco
in no time!

Afterward, Smart Falcon's efforts pay off
and she
successfully returns to her target
weight!
